description: Step-by-step guide to the New York LLC publication process, from the county clerk's newspaper designation to the Department of State's response on the Certificate of Publication: six consecutive weeks of publication, the affidavits of publication, the Certificate of Publication form for each entity type (DOS-1708-f domestic, DOS-1707-f foreign, DOS-1709-f PLLC, DOS-1710-f foreign PLLC), the $50 state filing fee, the Department's expedited handling fees, and a timeline of about 8 to 10 weeks. Situations: a new LLC, a foreign LLC, a PLLC, close to the 120-day deadline, or past it. Also covers opening a bank account and doing business while publication runs, and who Section 206(a) names as taking part. General information, not legal advice. Do NOT use for prices (use llc_publication_get_county_pricing), newspaper lookups (use llc_publication_get_county_info), or requirements and consequences (use llc_publication_check_requirements).
